title: 祭囃子に願いを乗せて

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So that's what a ceremonial dance looks like… My, it's so dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I agree. Truly, a wonderful dance full of grace and charm…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: We should all get out there and do the ceremonial dance ourselves! Ooh, let's do a mambo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wow, how radical! That could work… I guess?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It won't. El, I hope you plan to do the proper dance, yes?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Claro, claro… I remember how to do it, I swear…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All righty! Let's hammer this into our heads, Nature!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hm? You don't wanna dance or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, I wouldn't say that… It's just that this dance is way out of my league.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Imagine how strange I'd look in such a dazzling dance.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The Fleetfoot Festival is for all Umamusume to attend… Everyone there has the capacity to shine on that stage.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Really! That's why we've gotta work hard to step up! Ei, ei, mun!
